name: WF02 - Request Client Data - Implementation Complete

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::text AS invocation_kind,
        $2::text AS trigger_source,

        $3::uuid AS supplied_case_id,
        $4::uuid AS supplied_correlation_id,

        NULLIF(btrim($5::text), '')
            AS supplied_request_cycle_key,

        $6::uuid AS supplied_failed_submission_id,
        $7::uuid AS supplied_external_operation_id,

        NULLIF(btrim($8::text), '')
            AS recovery_reason,

        $9::text AS form_base_url,
        $10::integer AS token_ttl_hours,
        $11::integer AS token_ttl_seconds,
        $12::text AS encryption_key_id,
        $13::integer AS operation_lease_seconds,
        $14::integer AS operation_max_attempts,
        $15::text AS sender_name,

        NULLIF(btrim($16::text), '')
            AS support_contact
),

loaded AS (
    SELECT
        input.*,

        onboarding_case.id
            AS authoritative_case_id,

        onboarding_case.correlation_id
            AS authoritative_correlation_id,

        onboarding_case.state
            AS authoritative_case_state,

        onboarding_case.source_system,
        onboarding_case.source_deal_id,

        NULLIF(
            btrim(
                onboarding_case.intake_contact_email
            ),
            ''
        ) AS intake_contact_email,

        collect_step.id
            AS collect_step_id,

        collect_step.status
            AS collect_step_status,

        collect_step.attempt_count
            AS collect_step_attempt_count,

        failed_submission.id
            AS authoritative_failed_submission_id,

        failed_submission.case_id
            AS failed_submission_case_id,

        failed_submission.validation_status
            AS failed_submission_validation_status,

        retry_operation.id
            AS authoritative_external_operation_id,

        retry_operation.case_id
            AS operation_case_id,

        retry_operation.operation_type,
        retry_operation.status
            AS operation_status,

        retry_operation.attempt_count
            AS operation_attempt_count,

        retry_operation.max_attempts
            AS operation_max_attempts_persisted,

        retry_operation.next_retry_at,
        retry_operation.lease_owner,
        retry_operation.lease_expires_at,
        retry_operation.external_id,

        NULLIF(
            btrim(
                retry_operation.request_summary
                    ->> 'token_id'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS operation_token_id,

        NULLIF(
            btrim(
                retry_operation.request_summary
                    ->> 'request_cycle_key'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS operation_request_cycle_key,

        NULLIF(
            btrim(
                retry_operation.request_summary
                    ->> 'recipient_email'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS operation_recipient_email,

        NULLIF(
            btrim(
                retry_operation.request_summary
                    ->> 'template_key'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS operation_template_key,

        NULLIF(
            btrim(
                retry_operation.request_summary
                    ->> 'message_marker'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS operation_message_marker

    FROM input

    LEFT JOIN onboarding_cases
        AS onboarding_case
        ON onboarding_case.id =
            input.supplied_case_id

    LEFT JOIN onboarding_steps
        AS collect_step
        ON collect_step.case_id =
            onboarding_case.id
       AND collect_step.step_type =
            'collect_client_data'

    LEFT JOIN onboarding_submissions
        AS failed_submission
        ON failed_submission.id =
            input.supplied_failed_submission_id

    LEFT JOIN external_operations
        AS retry_operation
        ON retry_operation.id =
            input.supplied_external_operation_id
)

SELECT
    invocation_kind,
    trigger_source,

    supplied_case_id,
    supplied_correlation_id,
    supplied_request_cycle_key,
    supplied_failed_submission_id,
    supplied_external_operation_id,
    recovery_reason,

    authoritative_case_id,
    authoritative_correlation_id,
    authoritative_case_state,

    source_system,
    source_deal_id,
    intake_contact_email,

    collect_step_id,
    collect_step_status,
    collect_step_attempt_count,

    authoritative_failed_submission_id,
    failed_submission_case_id,
    failed_submission_validation_status,

    authoritative_external_operation_id,
    operation_case_id,
    operation_type,
    operation_status,
    operation_attempt_count,
    operation_max_attempts_persisted,
    next_retry_at,
    lease_owner,
    lease_expires_at,
    external_id,

    operation_token_id,
    operation_request_cycle_key,
    operation_recipient_email,
    operation_template_key,
    operation_message_marker,

    form_base_url,
    token_ttl_hours,
    token_ttl_seconds,
    encryption_key_id,
    operation_lease_seconds,
    operation_max_attempts,
    sender_name,
    support_contact,

    authoritative_case_id IS NOT NULL
        AS case_found,

    collect_step_id IS NOT NULL
        AS collect_step_found,

    authoritative_failed_submission_id
        IS NOT NULL
        AS failed_submission_found,

    authoritative_external_operation_id
        IS NOT NULL
        AS external_operation_found

FROM loaded;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::jsonb AS input_context,
        $2::uuid AS case_id,
        $3::text AS request_cycle_key,
        clock_timestamp() AS database_now
),

same_cycle_token AS (
    SELECT
        token.*
    FROM onboarding_form_tokens AS token
    JOIN input
      ON input.case_id = token.case_id
     AND input.request_cycle_key = token.request_cycle_key
    LIMIT 1
),

active_token AS (
    SELECT
        token.*
    FROM onboarding_form_tokens AS token
    JOIN input
      ON input.case_id = token.case_id
    WHERE token.status IN (
        'issued',
        'delivered'
    )
    ORDER BY token.issued_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

same_cycle_operation AS (
    SELECT
        operation.*
    FROM external_operations AS operation
    JOIN input
      ON input.case_id = operation.case_id
    JOIN same_cycle_token AS token
      ON TRUE
    WHERE operation.operation_type =
          'send_client_data_request'
      AND operation.request_summary ->> 'token_id' =
          token.id::text
      AND operation.request_summary ->> 'request_cycle_key' =
          input.request_cycle_key
    ORDER BY operation.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    input.input_context,

    input.database_now,

    token.id::text AS cycle_token_id,
    token.request_cycle_key AS cycle_token_request_cycle_key,
    token.status AS cycle_token_status,
    token.expires_at AS cycle_token_expires_at,
    token.issued_at AS cycle_token_issued_at,
    token.delivered_at AS cycle_token_delivered_at,

    (
        token.token_ciphertext IS NOT NULL
        AND token.token_nonce IS NOT NULL
        AND token.token_auth_tag IS NOT NULL
        AND token.encryption_key_id IS NOT NULL
    ) AS cycle_has_encrypted_material,

    token.encryption_key_id AS cycle_encryption_key_id,

    active.id::text AS active_token_id,
    active.request_cycle_key AS active_token_request_cycle_key,
    active.status AS active_token_status,
    active.expires_at AS active_token_expires_at,

    operation.id::text AS existing_operation_id,
    operation.status AS existing_operation_status,
    operation.attempt_count AS existing_operation_attempt_count,
    operation.max_attempts AS existing_operation_max_attempts,
    operation.next_retry_at AS existing_operation_next_retry_at,
    operation.lease_owner AS existing_operation_lease_owner,
    operation.lease_expires_at AS existing_operation_lease_expires_at,
    operation.external_id AS existing_operation_external_id,

    CASE
        WHEN token.id IS NULL
         AND active.id IS NULL
        THEN 'new_token_required'

        WHEN token.id IS NULL
         AND active.status = 'issued'
         AND active.expires_at <= input.database_now
        THEN 'expire_other_issued_token_then_create'

        WHEN token.id IS NULL
         AND active.id IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'blocked_by_other_active_cycle'

        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
         AND token.expires_at > input.database_now
        THEN 'reuse_issued_token'

        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
         AND token.expires_at <= input.database_now
        THEN 'same_cycle_token_expired'

        WHEN token.status = 'delivered'
        THEN 'same_cycle_delivered'

        WHEN token.status IN (
            'consumed',
            'expired',
            'revoked'
        )
        THEN 'same_cycle_closed'

        ELSE 'unexpected_token_state'
    END AS cycle_inspection_decision

FROM input
LEFT JOIN same_cycle_token AS token
       ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN active_token AS active
       ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN same_cycle_operation AS operation
       ON TRUE;

WITH prepared AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM prepare_client_data_form_token(
        $1::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        $3::text,
        NULLIF($4::text, '')::uuid,
        $5::uuid,
        decode($6::text, 'base64'),
        decode($7::text, 'base64'),
        decode($8::text, 'base64'),
        decode($9::text, 'base64'),
        $10::text,
        $11::integer
    )
)

SELECT
    $12::jsonb AS input_context,
    prepared.*
FROM prepared;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::jsonb AS input_context,
        $2::uuid AS case_id,
        $3::uuid AS correlation_id,
        $4::text AS request_cycle_key,
        NULLIF($5::text, '')::uuid AS failed_submission_id,
        clock_timestamp() AS database_now
),

case_row AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT onboarding_case.*
    FROM onboarding_cases AS onboarding_case
    JOIN input
      ON input.case_id = onboarding_case.id
    FOR UPDATE
),

collect_step_row AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT step.*
    FROM onboarding_steps AS step
    JOIN input
      ON input.case_id = step.case_id
    WHERE step.step_type = 'collect_client_data'
    FOR UPDATE
),

token_row AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT token.*
    FROM onboarding_form_tokens AS token
    JOIN input
      ON input.case_id = token.case_id
     AND input.request_cycle_key =
         token.request_cycle_key
    FOR UPDATE
),

failed_submission_row AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT submission.*
    FROM onboarding_submissions AS submission
    JOIN input
      ON input.case_id = submission.case_id
     AND input.failed_submission_id =
         submission.id
)

SELECT
    input.input_context,

    CASE
        WHEN onboarding_case.id IS NULL
        THEN 'case_not_found'

        WHEN onboarding_case.correlation_id
             IS DISTINCT FROM input.correlation_id
        THEN 'correlation_mismatch'

        WHEN input.request_cycle_key = 'initial'
         AND input.failed_submission_id IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'invalid_initial_cycle_identity'

        WHEN input.request_cycle_key <> 'initial'
         AND (
             input.failed_submission_id IS NULL
             OR input.request_cycle_key <>
                (
                    'validation_failed:' ||
                    input.failed_submission_id::text
                )
         )
        THEN 'invalid_correction_cycle_identity'

        WHEN input.request_cycle_key <> 'initial'
         AND (
             failed_submission.id IS NULL
             OR failed_submission.validation_status <>
                'failed'
         )
        THEN 'invalid_failed_submission'

        WHEN collect_step.id IS NULL
        THEN 'collect_step_not_found'

        WHEN token.id IS NULL
        THEN 'same_cycle_token_not_found'

        /*
         * Another worker may have completed delivery
         * after the previous authoritative inspection.
         */
        WHEN token.status = 'delivered'
         AND onboarding_case.state =
             'awaiting_client_data'
         AND collect_step.status =
             'in_progress'
        THEN 'same_cycle_already_delivered'

        WHEN token.status = 'delivered'
        THEN 'delivered_token_state_mismatch'

        WHEN input.request_cycle_key = 'initial'
         AND onboarding_case.state <> 'created'
        THEN 'invalid_case_state'

        WHEN input.request_cycle_key <> 'initial'
         AND onboarding_case.state <>
             'validation_failed'
        THEN 'invalid_case_state'

        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
         AND token.expires_at <= input.database_now
        THEN 'same_cycle_token_expired'

        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
         AND (
             token.token_hash IS NULL
             OR octet_length(token.token_hash) <> 32
             OR token.token_ciphertext IS NULL
             OR octet_length(
                 token.token_ciphertext
             ) <> 32
             OR token.token_nonce IS NULL
             OR octet_length(
                 token.token_nonce
             ) <> 12
             OR token.token_auth_tag IS NULL
             OR octet_length(
                 token.token_auth_tag
             ) <> 16
             OR token.encryption_key_id IS NULL
             OR btrim(
                 token.encryption_key_id
             ) = ''
         )
        THEN 'invalid_existing_token_crypto'

        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
         AND collect_step.status NOT IN (
             'in_progress',
             'failed_retryable'
         )
        THEN 'existing_token_step_mismatch'

        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
        THEN 'reused_issued_token'

        ELSE 'same_cycle_already_closed'
    END AS prepare_outcome,

    token.id AS authoritative_token_id,
    token.status AS authoritative_token_status,
    token.expires_at AS authoritative_token_expires_at,

    CASE
        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
        THEN encode(
            token.token_hash,
            'base64'
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS authoritative_token_hash_base64,

    CASE
        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
        THEN encode(
            token.token_ciphertext,
            'base64'
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS authoritative_token_ciphertext_base64,

    CASE
        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
        THEN encode(
            token.token_nonce,
            'base64'
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS authoritative_token_nonce_base64,

    CASE
        WHEN token.status = 'issued'
        THEN encode(
            token.token_auth_tag,
            'base64'
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS authoritative_token_auth_tag_base64,

    token.encryption_key_id
        AS authoritative_encryption_key_id,

    false AS token_created,

    collect_step.id AS collect_step_id,

    collect_step.attempt_count
        AS collect_step_attempt_count,

    NULL::uuid AS expired_stale_token_id,

    input.database_now

FROM input

LEFT JOIN case_row AS onboarding_case
       ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN collect_step_row AS collect_step
       ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN token_row AS token
       ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN failed_submission_row
       AS failed_submission
       ON TRUE;

nodes.name: Build Unexpected Token Prepare Decision Error

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::jsonb AS input_context,
        $2::uuid AS case_id,
        $3::uuid AS correlation_id,
        $4::uuid AS token_id,
        $5::text AS request_cycle_key,
        $6::text AS recipient_email,
        $7::text AS template_key,

        (
            'onboarding:' ||
            $2::uuid::text ||
            ':form-token:' ||
            $4::uuid::text ||
            ':send-client-data-request'
        ) AS idempotency_key
),

snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        input.*,

        onboarding_case.id
            AS authoritative_case_id,

        onboarding_case.correlation_id
            AS authoritative_correlation_id,

        onboarding_case.state
            AS authoritative_case_state,

        collect_step.id
            AS authoritative_collect_step_id,

        collect_step.status
            AS authoritative_collect_step_status,

        token.id
            AS authoritative_token_id,

        token.status
            AS authoritative_token_status,

        token.request_cycle_key
            AS authoritative_request_cycle_key,

        token.delivered_at
            AS authoritative_token_delivered_at,

        operation.id
            AS authoritative_operation_id,

        operation.operation_type
            AS authoritative_operation_type,

        operation.status
            AS authoritative_operation_status,

        operation.external_id
            AS authoritative_external_id,

        operation.request_summary
            AS authoritative_request_summary,

        operation.response_summary
            AS authoritative_response_summary

    FROM input

    LEFT JOIN onboarding_cases
        AS onboarding_case
      ON onboarding_case.id =
         input.case_id

    LEFT JOIN onboarding_steps
        AS collect_step
      ON collect_step.case_id =
         input.case_id
     AND collect_step.step_type =
         'collect_client_data'

    LEFT JOIN onboarding_form_tokens
        AS token
      ON token.id =
         input.token_id
     AND token.case_id =
         input.case_id

    LEFT JOIN external_operations
        AS operation
      ON operation.idempotency_key =
         input.idempotency_key
)

SELECT
    snapshot.input_context,

    snapshot.authoritative_case_id,
    snapshot.authoritative_correlation_id,
    snapshot.authoritative_case_state,

    snapshot.authoritative_collect_step_id,
    snapshot.authoritative_collect_step_status,

    snapshot.authoritative_token_id,
    snapshot.authoritative_token_status,
    snapshot.authoritative_request_cycle_key,
    snapshot.authoritative_token_delivered_at,

    snapshot.authoritative_operation_id,
    snapshot.authoritative_operation_status,
    snapshot.authoritative_external_id,

    snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
        ->> 'message_marker'
        AS authoritative_message_marker,

    CASE
        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_case_id
             IS NULL
        THEN 'case_not_found'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_correlation_id
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.correlation_id
        THEN 'correlation_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_case_state
             <> 'awaiting_client_data'
        THEN 'case_state_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_collect_step_id
             IS NULL
        THEN 'collect_step_not_found'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_collect_step_status
             <> 'in_progress'
        THEN 'collect_step_state_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_token_id
             IS NULL
        THEN 'token_not_found'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_token_status
             <> 'delivered'
        THEN 'token_not_delivered'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_token_delivered_at
             IS NULL
        THEN 'token_delivery_timestamp_missing'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_request_cycle_key
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.request_cycle_key
        THEN 'token_cycle_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_operation_id
             IS NULL
        THEN 'operation_not_found'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_operation_type
             <> 'send_client_data_request'
        THEN 'operation_type_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_operation_status
             <> 'succeeded'
        THEN 'operation_not_succeeded'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_external_id
             IS NULL
          OR btrim(
                 snapshot.authoritative_external_id
             ) = ''
        THEN 'gmail_message_id_missing'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
             ->> 'token_id'
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.token_id::text
        THEN 'operation_token_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
             ->> 'request_cycle_key'
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.request_cycle_key
        THEN 'operation_cycle_mismatch'

        WHEN lower(
                 btrim(
                     snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
                     ->> 'recipient_email'
                 )
             )
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             lower(
                 btrim(
                     snapshot.recipient_email
                 )
             )
        THEN 'operation_recipient_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
             ->> 'template_key'
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.template_key
        THEN 'operation_template_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
             ->> 'message_marker'
             IS NULL
          OR btrim(
                 snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
                 ->> 'message_marker'
             ) = ''
        THEN 'operation_message_marker_missing'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_response_summary
             ->> 'provider'
             IS DISTINCT FROM 'gmail'
        THEN 'response_provider_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_response_summary
             ->> 'message_id'
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.authoritative_external_id
        THEN 'response_message_id_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_response_summary
             ->> 'message_marker'
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.authoritative_request_summary
             ->> 'message_marker'
        THEN 'response_message_marker_mismatch'

        WHEN snapshot.authoritative_response_summary
             ->> 'template_key'
             IS DISTINCT FROM
             snapshot.template_key
        THEN 'response_template_mismatch'

        ELSE 'already_delivered_consistent'
    END AS delivered_validation_decision

FROM snapshot;

parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM claim_external_operation(
        $2::text,
        $3::text,
        $4::uuid,
        $5::text,
        $6::integer,
        $7::integer,
        $8::jsonb
    )
)

SELECT
    $1::jsonb AS input_context,

    claimed.operation_id,
    claimed.claim_outcome,
    claimed.operation_status,
    claimed.current_attempt_count,
    claimed.configured_max_attempts,
    claimed.current_lease_expires_at,
    claimed.current_external_id,
    claimed.current_response_summary

FROM claimed;

WITH finalized AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM finalize_wf02_exhausted_delivery(
        $2::uuid,
        $3::uuid,
        $4::uuid,
        $5::text,
        $6::jsonb
    )
)

SELECT
    $1::jsonb AS input_context,
    finalized.finalization_outcome,
    finalized.final_operation_status,
    finalized.final_step_status,
    finalized.final_token_status,
    finalized.final_attempt_count

FROM finalized;

parameters.query:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        $1::uuid AS operation_id,
        $2::uuid AS case_id,
        $3::uuid AS token_id,
        $4::text AS request_cycle_key,
        $5::text AS lease_owner,
        clock_timestamp() AS checked_at
)

SELECT
    parameters.checked_at,

    external_operation.id IS NOT NULL
        AS operation_exists,

    external_operation.id
        AS authoritative_operation_id,

    external_operation.case_id
        AS authoritative_operation_case_id,

    external_operation.operation_type
        AS authoritative_operation_type,

    external_operation.idempotency_key
        AS authoritative_operation_idempotency_key,

    external_operation.status
        AS authoritative_operation_status,

    external_operation.attempt_count
        AS authoritative_operation_attempt_count,

    external_operation.max_attempts
        AS authoritative_operation_max_attempts,

    external_operation.lease_owner
        AS authoritative_operation_lease_owner,

    external_operation.lease_expires_at
        AS authoritative_operation_lease_expires_at,

    external_operation.external_id
        AS authoritative_operation_external_id,

    external_operation.request_summary
        AS authoritative_operation_request_summary,

    onboarding_case.id IS NOT NULL
        AS case_exists,

    onboarding_case.id
        AS authoritative_case_id,

    onboarding_case.correlation_id
        AS authoritative_correlation_id,

    onboarding_case.state
        AS authoritative_case_state,

    onboarding_case.intake_contact_email
        AS authoritative_recipient_email,

    collect_step.id IS NOT NULL
        AS collect_step_exists,

    collect_step.id
        AS authoritative_collect_step_id,

    collect_step.status
        AS authoritative_collect_step_status,

    collect_step.attempt_count
        AS authoritative_collect_step_attempt_count,

    form_token.id IS NOT NULL
        AS token_exists,

    form_token.id
        AS authoritative_token_id,

    form_token.request_cycle_key
        AS authoritative_token_request_cycle_key,

    form_token.status
        AS authoritative_token_status,

    form_token.issued_at
        AS authoritative_token_issued_at,

    form_token.expires_at
        AS authoritative_token_expires_at

FROM parameters

LEFT JOIN external_operations AS external_operation
    ON external_operation.id =
       parameters.operation_id

LEFT JOIN onboarding_cases AS onboarding_case
    ON onboarding_case.id =
       parameters.case_id

LEFT JOIN onboarding_steps AS collect_step
    ON collect_step.case_id =
       parameters.case_id
   AND collect_step.step_type =
       'collect_client_data'

LEFT JOIN onboarding_form_tokens AS form_token
    ON form_token.id =
       parameters.token_id
   AND form_token.case_id =
       parameters.case_id
   AND form_token.request_cycle_key =

WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        $1::uuid AS operation_id,
        $2::uuid AS case_id,
        $3::uuid AS token_id,
        $4::text AS request_cycle_key,
        $5::text AS lease_owner,
        clock_timestamp() AS checked_at
)

SELECT
    parameters.checked_at,

    external_operation.id IS NOT NULL
        AS operation_exists,

    external_operation.id
        AS authoritative_operation_id,

    external_operation.case_id
        AS authoritative_operation_case_id,

    external_operation.operation_type
        AS authoritative_operation_type,

    external_operation.idempotency_key
        AS authoritative_operation_idempotency_key,

    external_operation.status
        AS authoritative_operation_status,

    external_operation.attempt_count
        AS authoritative_operation_attempt_count,

    external_operation.max_attempts
        AS authoritative_operation_max_attempts,

    external_operation.lease_owner
        AS authoritative_operation_lease_owner,

    external_operation.lease_expires_at
        AS authoritative_operation_lease_expires_at,

    external_operation.external_id
        AS authoritative_operation_external_id,

    external_operation.request_summary
        AS authoritative_operation_request_summary,

    onboarding_case.id IS NOT NULL
        AS case_exists,

    onboarding_case.id
        AS authoritative_case_id,

    onboarding_case.correlation_id
        AS authoritative_correlation_id,

    onboarding_case.state
        AS authoritative_case_state,

    onboarding_case.intake_contact_email
        AS authoritative_recipient_email,

    collect_step.id IS NOT NULL
        AS collect_step_exists,

    collect_step.id
        AS authoritative_collect_step_id,

    collect_step.status
        AS authoritative_collect_step_status,

    collect_step.attempt_count
        AS authoritative_collect_step_attempt_count,

    form_token.id IS NOT NULL
        AS token_exists,

    form_token.id
        AS authoritative_token_id,

    form_token.request_cycle_key
        AS authoritative_token_request_cycle_key,

    form_token.status
        AS authoritative_token_status,

    form_token.issued_at
        AS authoritative_token_issued_at,

    form_token.expires_at
        AS authoritative_token_expires_at

FROM parameters

LEFT JOIN external_operations AS external_operation
    ON external_operation.id =
       parameters.operation_id

LEFT JOIN onboarding_cases AS onboarding_case
    ON onboarding_case.id =
       parameters.case_id

LEFT JOIN onboarding_steps AS collect_step
    ON collect_step.case_id =
       parameters.case_id
   AND collect_step.step_type =
       'collect_client_data'

LEFT JOIN onboarding_form_tokens AS form_token
    ON form_token.id =
       parameters.token_id
   AND form_token.case_id =
       parameters.case_id
   AND form_token.request_cycle_key =
       parameters.request_cycle_key;
